name: AlpacaEval 2.0
intro: AlpacaEval 2.0 是一个自动化评估框架：仅在送审前随机交换基线与候选回复顺序，解析连续偏好后对已交换样本执行 3 − 偏好值并撤销列交换，从而恢复候选/基线方向；候选获胜概率为偏好值 − 1。随后计算加权胜率与长度控制胜率，以降低偏好长回答的偏差。
build_method: 固定805条指令与基线/候选回复, 仅在送审前随机交换输出顺序并执行单token成对评审, 解析连续偏好后对已交换样本执行3 − 偏好值并撤销输出列交换, 恢复候选/基线方向后计算候选获胜概率偏好值 − 1, 再进入加权胜率与反对称长度控制GLM；分开披露论文v2的L2规范与官方0.6.6的L1实现
metric: Weighted Win Rate, LC Win Rate
task_type: 排序, 对话, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 成对偏好, 送审前随机顺序, 解析后恢复候选方向, 长度控制, 抗长度偏差
build_method_en: Use the fixed 805-instruction set with baseline and candidate responses; randomize output order only before judging with the single-token pairwise evaluator; after parsing, apply 3 − preference to switched rows and undo the output column swap to restore candidate/baseline direction; compute candidate win probability as preference − 1; then calculate weighted win rate and an antisymmetric length-controlled GLM, with paper-v2 L2 disclosed separately from official 0.6.6 L1
eval_feature_en: Pairwise Preference, Pre-Judge Order Randomization, Post-Parse Candidate-Direction Restoration, Length Control, Verbosity-Bias Mitigation
intro_en: AlpacaEval 2.0 randomizes baseline and candidate response order only before GPT-4-based pairwise judging. After parsing the continuous preference, switched rows receive 3 − preference and the output columns are unswapped, restoring the original baseline/candidate direction; candidate win probability is preference − 1. Weighted and length-controlled win rates are then computed to reduce bias toward longer responses.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.04475v2 §2–§4 and tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval package 0.6.6 at revision cd543a149df89434d8a54582c0151c0b945c3d20. The shared contract is the fixed 805 instructions, gpt-4-1106-preview baseline, weighted_alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo single-token judging, token-logprob continuous preference, weighted win rate, and an antisymmetric GLM over model identity, output length, and instruction difficulty. Randomization is pre-judge only: pinned src/alpaca_eval/processors.py RandomSwitchTwoColumnsProcessor swaps output_1/output_2 before formatting, then after parsing applies 3 − preference to switched rows and undoes the column swap, restoring baseline = output_1 and candidate = output_2. Thus candidate win probability is preference − 1, not a preference that preserves randomized A/B order; the restore makes the result swap-symmetric. The paper specifies five-fold CV with L2, while the pinned official implementation in src/alpaca_eval/metrics/glm_winrate.py uses five-fold CV with L1 and liblinear; these are parallel version disclosures, not one implementation chain. Setting the length term to zero yields LC win rate with self-50% and swap symmetry after direction restoration.
